title.zh: 将邦阿西楠省 Bayambang市镇 Sancagulis 社区学校的名称变更为Cason 社区学校的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Sancagulis Community School in the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan, to Cason Community School
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of the Sancagulis Community School in the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan, to Cason Community School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Sancagulis Community tại Đô thị Bayambang, Tỉnh Pangasinan thành Trường Cason Community
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียน Sancagulis Community ในเทศบาล Bayambang จังหวัด Pangasinan เป็นโรงเรียน Cason Community
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Sancagulis Community di Kotamadya Bayambang, Provinsi Pangasinan menjadi Sekolah Cason Community
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Sancagulis Community di Perbandaran Bayambang, Wilayah Pangasinan kepada Sekolah Cason Community

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2193_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Sancagulis Community School in the Municipality of Bayambang, Province of Pangasinan, is hereby changed to Cason Community School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 7, 1959.
